case_title: BOIDES FRANKLIN-REPRESENTING 565 GEARY PARTNERS VS MONTGOMERY KONE INC

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,500.00 FILED BY BOIDES FRANKLIN-REPRESENTING 565 GEARY PARTNERS AS TO DEFENDANT MONTGOMERY KONE INC ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-20-1995 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT C
